description: Fetch a Twitch channel's profile and current live status via Twitch's internal GraphQL (no login). Returns display name, follower count, description, avatar, and — when the channel is broadcasting — live title, category, viewer count, and start time. Use twitch/get-channel-videos and twitch/get-channel-clips for the channel's content lists. No login required.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel login name — the path segment in twitch.tv/{channel} (e.g. "gorgc" from twitch.tv/gorgc). Case-insensitive ("LCK" resolves to "lck"). Found in any live card, video, or clip URL, or via twitch/search --type channel. Non-existent channels return CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND.
